review_evidence: README identifies printiest as a general algebraic pretty-printer implementation for Lean using a particular document-layout algorithm.
Complete scan of its six primary Lean files found 97 declaration-style implementation items and zero theorem, lemma, axiom or proposition-example declarations.
The source implements document layout, measuring/rendering and stream output without a proved printer specification or independent mathematical development.
